title: Hiroshi OS
subtitle: Durable AI execution engine
description: A Rust engine and GPUIX desktop for model and tool workflows.
notes: SQLite persistence, typed HTTP and replay feeds, provider adapters, tool execution, cancellation, context compaction, and crash recovery.
The desktop and broader multi-agent workflow are still in development.

title: hookrelay
subtitle: Webhook delivery
description: Signed webhook delivery with retries and replay.
notes: SKIP LOCKED workers, HMAC signatures, jittered retries, a dead-letter queue, replay, and stale-claim recovery.
A recorded single-host fault run delivered 10,000 events across five process restarts. Delivery is at-least-once.

title: quorumkv
subtitle: Raft key-value store
description: A key-value store with Raft consensus and quorum-confirmed reads.
notes: Implemented elections, replication, conflict-index rollback, quorum commits, a write-ahead log, and ReadIndex.
The recorded in-process fault run passed 500/500 consistent-read histories. Plain local reads can be stale.

title: lsmstore
subtitle: LSM storage engine
description: A single-node storage engine built around a write-ahead log and SSTables.
notes: Skiplist memtables, SSTables, bloom filters, leveled compaction, and crash/property tests.
After fixing a flush bug, the recorded process-kill suite lost none of 8,428 acknowledged writes across 220 runs.

title: Bagrry
subtitle: Local-first AI notepad
description: A desktop notepad with local storage, transcription, and AI tools.
notes: Embedded SQLite, audio transcription, and model-assisted note enhancement.
Local REST and MCP interfaces expose notes and search to other tools.

title: Kale
subtitle: LLVM compilation pipeline
description: A compiler experiment from parsing to native code generation.
notes: Lexer, recursive-descent parser, AST modules, and LLVM IR generation.
Symbol resolution, stack-frame allocation, and native code generation using LLVMLite.

title: ringcache
subtitle: Distributed in-memory cache
description: A replicated cache with consistent hashing, TTLs, and LRU eviction.
notes: Three-node setup with two replicas and failure demonstrations.
In-memory and last-writer-wins; writes require one acknowledgement. It is not durable or linearizable.

title: logship
subtitle: Partitioned commit log
description: A segmented event log with consumer groups and replication.
notes: Sparse indexes, partitions, group rebalancing, replica watermarks, and broker-failure experiments.
Membership is static. Network splits can permit dual writes; this is not a consensus-backed log.

title: ledgerd
subtitle: Double-entry ledger
description: A transactional ledger with idempotent payment workflows.
notes: Double-entry accounting, transactional idempotency, a payment state machine, and property/failure tests.
Uses a simulated processor rather than real payment rails.

title: tenderlens
subtitle: Tender ingestion and search
description: Source adapters, deduplication, search, and alerts for public tenders.
notes: Incremental ingestion, full-text search, and alert workers.
Source availability and captcha restrictions limit ingestion coverage.

title: Toollearn
subtitle: Tool-use adaptation experiments
description: A reproducible harness for small-model tool-use adaptation.
notes: Virtual file tools, completion-masked training, teacher trajectory collection, and baseline/adapter evaluation.
Tiny-model training and checkpoint reload were exercised locally. Pretrained-model quality gains remain unmeasured.

title: Toolrecover
subtitle: Reward and preference experiments
description: Controlled experiments in tool recovery, policy optimization, and preferences.
notes: Recovery simulator, private state verifier, supervised baseline, grouped policy updates, DPO, and reward-model training.
Local runs did not establish an RL improvement. Human-data and AI-judge GPU studies remain pending.

title: Kernelbench
subtitle: Inference kernel experiments
description: RMSNorm and softmax experiments with reproducible measurement tooling.
notes: Masked kernels, numerical-error reports, eager/compiled comparisons, and distributed gradient checks.
Two-process CPU/Gloo validation ran on Windows. CUDA kernel execution and multi-GPU NCCL validation remain pending; no GPU speedup is claimed.

title: T3D
subtitle: Desktop code editor
description: A desktop editor with native terminals and a bounded AI tool loop.
notes: PTY terminals, split editing, Git integration, extension packaging, and workspace file tools.
Model/tool rounds support cancellation and partial results. Workspace path checks are not a complete security sandbox.

title: shipgate
subtitle: Release gate demo
description: Health-gated staging-to-production promotion with approvals.
notes: Promotion flow, rollback hooks, and an audit trail.
A demo with limited authentication; further polish is pending.

title: linejudge
subtitle: Code review pipeline
description: Webhook-driven review jobs with static checks and an optional model stage.
notes: A review pipeline and evaluation harness.
Recorded scores use a mock provider on five fixtures. They do not measure real-model review quality; further polish is pending.

title: fencepost
subtitle: Leased job queue · in progress
description: A PostgreSQL job queue with leases and fencing.
notes: Implementation is in PR #1 in the October 26 review; the default branch contains only a README.
Includes cron and a chaos harness. Fenced effects require a participating sink.

title: pagedb
subtitle: Page storage engine · in progress
description: A B+tree storage experiment with MVCC and recovery.
notes: Implementation and reports are in PR #1 in the October 26 review; the default branch contains only a README.
Includes a double-write buffer. Snapshot isolation does not imply serializability.

title: shardvault
subtitle: Erasure-coded storage · in progress
description: An erasure-coded object store with fault experiments.
notes: Implementation and recorded chaos tests are in PR #1 in the October 26 review; the default branch contains only a README.
An S3-like interface does not imply an AWS deployment.

title: postings
subtitle: Search index · in progress
description: A Java search indexing core, server, and benchmark harness.
notes: Implementation is in PR #1 in the October 26 review; the default branch contains only a README.
Includes tests; performance has not been established by the reviewed documentation.

title: steerlb
subtitle: L7 proxy · in progress
description: An HTTP load-balancing experiment with failure scenarios.
notes: Implementation is in PR #1 in the October 26 review; the default branch contains only a README.
Recorded kill/restart and retry-storm regressions remain unresolved.

title: bidready
subtitle: Document retrieval workflows
description: PDF ingestion, retrieval, and cited document workflows.
notes: OCR, BM25 retrieval, citations, and verification.
Default-branch evaluation uses mock/rule behavior. Model-improvement work was unmerged in the October 26 review.

title: agentbank
subtitle: Virtual ledger and tools
description: A virtual ledger exposed through REST and MCP.
notes: Payroll and card workflows with tests.
Uses simulated currency rather than real financial rails.

title: Hypr
subtitle: Terminal coding agent
description: A terminal agent with schema-validated tools and MCP support.
notes: Tool execution and daemon modules. No latency benchmark is claimed.

title: Hiro
subtitle: Desktop automation
description: A desktop automation application with native commands and model providers.
notes: Native automation commands and provider integration. Safety and performance guarantees have not been independently established.

title: Parable
subtitle: Desktop editor
description: A desktop editor with Git integration and a model tool-call loop.
notes: Search, sandboxing, LSP, and planning are listed as future work in the reviewed README.

title: inkwell
subtitle: Publishing application
description: A publishing application with a Go API, web frontend, and Android client.
notes: CRUD, authentication, and a feed. The reviewed version uses LIKE search and demo authentication.

title: gene
subtitle: Local retrieval assistant
description: A Kotlin application with local retrieval and an optional model gateway.
notes: The optional server does not yet include authentication or a database.

title: HyperCode
subtitle: Terminal ReAct agent
description: A small terminal agent with file and command tools.
notes: A compact experiment in model-driven file and command execution.
